Title: Azure Cloud and Direct Billing Are Now Generally Available in Kaleido's Blockchain Platform

Body.Content:
Kaleido users who would like to run on Azure can now select Azure as the cloud provider for their blockchain. Additionally, existing consortia who are looking to grow and scale their networks can now extend their blockchain networks on Azure. 

With the addition of the new Azure billing option, customers who choose to deploy their solution on Microsoft Azure can now set up payment directly through Microsoft Azure on any of Kaleido’s Pay-as-You-Go or Annual plans.

Learn More
